answer: Open agent markets can block Sybil farming by binding each active agent in a relay lagoon to one random /24 subnet ticket and a 150-credit escrow every 6 hours, burning 100% of double-claimed bonds. An honest agent commits 150 refundable credits on one network address to reach a bidding summit, while 600 fakes require 600 independent /24 blocks and 90,000 locked credits. Funneling extra personas through a shared VPN bridge fails peer ticket verification and forfeits the stake, though this defense fails if a cartel controls diverse ISP address pools.
